purpose: Curated target selection only, not a calculable catalog or redistributable astrometric measurements
selectionSource: VirgoStars backend star names cross-identified to IAU catalog names/HIP IDs using original and curated IAU references and SIMBAD query URLs. Historic aliases and unresolved names separately reviewed; no Swiss/Astrodienst catalog measurements copied.

stars.name: Sirius
stars.review: Spectroscopic binary; verify resolved source/component identity

stars.name: Regulus
stars.review: Bright multiple system; confirm RV source convention

stars.name: Spica
stars.review: Binary star; confirm component and adopted astrometric solution

stars.name: Aldebaran
stars.review: Not recovered in Gaia DR3 according to SIMBAD; Hipparcos identity important

stars.name: Antares
stars.review: Variable red supergiant; verify photometry and astrometric reliability

stars.name: Arcturus
stars.review: High proper motion; use declared epoch and RV frame

stars.name: Vega
stars.review: Variable; not recovered in Gaia DR3 according to SIMBAD

stars.name: Fomalhaut
stars.review: Confirm primary object rather than companions

stars.name: Betelgeuse
stars.review: Variable supergiant; special-case astrometric uncertainties

stars.name: Polaris
stars.review: Multiple system, variable; confirm specific component

stars.name: Altair
stars.review: Fast rotator; independently review RV and astrometric systematics

stars.name: Deneb
stars.review: Luminous variable supergiant; astrometric uncertainty and V photometry require review

stars.name: Procyon
stars.review: Resolved binary: verify primary component identity, orbital motion and RV

stars.name: Rigel
stars.review: Bright blue supergiant and multiple system; inspect astrometric solution

stars.name: Capella
stars.review: Multiple spectroscopic binary; HIP solution and system RV require special review

stars.name: Canopus
stars.review: Review original Johnson V and barycentric radial velocity provenance

stars.name: Denebola

stars.name: Bellatrix

stars.name: Alpheratz

stars.review: Review astrometric precision and radial-velocity reference

stars.name: Alkaid

stars.name: Alioth

stars.name: Alnilam

stars.name: Alnitak

stars.name: El Nath
stars.review: Backend legacy El Nath name maps to IAU Elnath, HIP 25428. Preserve legacy name and explicitly verify alias/component before runtime use. V/RV astrometry still unreviewed.

stars.name: Mizar

stars.name: Dubhe
